mapper.select: SELECT sg.id, sg.sessions_id AS sessionsId, sg.goods_id AS goodsId, sg.flash_price AS flashPrice, sg.flash_stock AS flashStock, sg.list_order AS listOrder, g.name AS goodsName, g.title AS goodsTitle, g.logo AS goodsLogo, g.price AS originalPrice, g.stock AS goodsStock, g.on_un_sale AS onUnSale FROM mall_flash_sessions_goods sg INNER JOIN mall_goods g ON g.id = sg.goods_id AND g.is_delete = 0 WHERE sg.sessions_id = #{sessionsId} AND sg.is_delete = 0 ORDER BY sg.list_order ASC, sg.id ASC
